name: Fable Auckland, MGallery
positioning: Boutique art deco hotel in Windsor House, a 1920s building in Auckland's CBD
best_for: Travelers who want a central Auckland base with art deco character
Guests who want a suite with room to spread out

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Auckland's CBD.
The hotel's address is 58 Queen Street in the Auckland CBD.
The hotel was previously known as Hotel Grand Windsor.
Rooms range from the Classic rooms to the Duchess and Windsor Suites.
Rooms have amenities from Marihi Aotearoa.
Rooms have a T2 fine bone china tea set.
Each hot tub and sauna session is reserved for a single party.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
The hotel's art deco dining room offers a signature High Tea.
The hotel holds Qualmark Gold sustainable hotel status.

highlights.text: The hotel is set within Windsor House, a building from the 1920s.
Jewel tones and a nod to the hotel's art deco origins run throughout the property.
The Windsor Suite has two bedrooms and a lounge with a balcony.
The Duchess and Windsor Suites have a cocktail tray for making Fable cocktails in the room.
Rooms feature the Sofitel My Bed.

considerations.text: Valet parking is available for an extra fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the central location and boutique positioning.
